name: Amara Okafor
title: Director of Sustainability Programmes
bio: Leads cross-sector programmes connecting space agencies, industry and NGOs around measurable sustainability outcomes.

name: Hiroshi Tanaka
title: Head of Earth Observation Science
bio: Specialises in applying satellite Earth observation to climate adaptation and disaster response programmes worldwide.

name: Leila Haddad

name: Tomas Novak
title: Managing Partner

name: Priya Nair

bio: Advises on regulatory frameworks that keep the space sector innovative while supporting social and environmental goals.
